headline: Bitcoin is holding just above $80,000 on Sunday night in Asia as Iran tensions linger, while a cluster of wallet-security problems hits self-custody users ahead of a busy Fed week.

market.asOf: Prices read from Blockchain.com's price page at about 15:55 UTC (22:55 Bangkok) on Sun 25 Oct; CoinGecko showed BTC at $80,571 (+1.30%) at the same time. Fear & Greed from Alternative.me's index as of 05:00 UTC. Live prices are at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 54 (Neutral) on Alternative.me's Crypto Fear & Greed Index (0-100), updated 05:00 UTC; CoinGlass's index read 53 (Neutral)

stories.title: Bitcoin holds just above $80,000 after a weekend dip as Iran tensions linger
stories.summary: Bitcoin slipped below $80,000 on Saturday, its weakest level in more than a month, and has recovered to around $80,300-$80,800 on Sunday. There is still no new US strike on Iran and no deal. The US is cutting embassy staff across the Middle East over threats from Iran.
points: Saturday's dip took bitcoin to a five-week low near $79,100, per crypto.news.
The US is reducing staff at its embassies in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar and the UAE, AP reports via PBS.
Iran's foreign minister said on Sunday its policies stay the same "whether there is war or not", per ABC.
Bitcoin is about 35.9% below its all-time high of $126,080, per CryptoTicker.

sources.label: PBS/AP: US reducing staff at 4 Middle East embassies
ABC: Iran says war would not change its stance
CryptoTicker: Bitcoin, winter time and the Fed window

stories.title: Bad weekend for crypto security: Electrum flaw, Keystone data leak, CoinDCX loss, Initia still down
stories.summary: Several security problems landed at once. Electrum, a popular Bitcoin desktop wallet, fixed a critical flaw in version 4.8.3. Hardware wallet maker Keystone said customer names and home addresses leaked. India's CoinDCX confirmed a $16M loss, and the Initia blockchain is still paused after its exploit.
points: Electrum: all versions before 4.8.3 are affected. A malicious server could trick users who bumped a transaction fee into paying an attacker; the team urges everyone to upgrade, per crypto.news.

Keystone: its website was breached on 20 Oct and it disclosed this on 24 Oct. Recovery phrases and private keys were not exposed, but customers should expect fake refund or replacement offers (phishing), per Crypto Briefing.
CoinDCX confirmed a loss of 15.99M USDT from old, retired wallets in an incident on 21 Oct. It says it absorbed the loss and user funds are safe, per crypto.news.
Initia: about $2.7M was taken and swapped into 1,135.52 ETH. A fix is expected within a few days, with no restart time yet, per The Industry Spread.

sources.label: The Industry Spread: Initia stays halted

stories.title: Big week ahead: Fed on Wednesday, $11B bitcoin options expiry Friday
stories.summary: The Fed announces its rate decision on Wednesday and about $11B of bitcoin options expires on Friday. US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, had two days of outflows to end last week.
points: Fed: the range is 3.75-4.00%, and 94 of 100 economists in a Reuters poll expect a hold, per Kitco.
Deribit bitcoin options worth about $11B expire on Fri 30 Oct, per EthNews.
Spot bitcoin ETFs: about -$635.5M on Thu 22 Oct and -$137.9M on Fri 23 Oct, per crypto.news.
Q3 GDP and September PCE inflation both land Thursday morning US time.

sources.label: Kitco/Reuters: Fed to skip October, hike in December, economists say

briefs.title: Brazil votes today; prediction markets favour Flávio Bolsonaro
briefs.summary: Polymarket shows Flávio Bolsonaro at about 80% and Kalshi at 80% to beat Lula, while final polls are close. Counting starts when polls close at 4pm ET (03:00 Mon Bangkok), per The Rio Times.

briefs.title: South Korea delays its crypto tax again
briefs.summary: A 22% tax on crypto gains above 2.5M won, due on 1 Jan 2027, has been postponed with no new start date, per KuCoin News.

briefs.title: Samsung Wallet adds USDC transfers on Solana
briefs.summary: US users will be able to send USDC to more than 60 countries, rolling out this week, per CryptoTicker.

briefs.title: Tether signs 15 bitcoin mining firms to its open-source mining kit
briefs.summary: Bitmain, MicroBT, Canaan, Foundry and F2Pool are among them; version 1.0 is targeted before the end of 2026, per crypto.news.
